Legend of Zelda, The - The Wind Waker HD.name: The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker HD
Legend of Zelda, The - The Wind Waker HD.summary: The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker HD is a remaster of The Wind Waker with an alternate recreation of the original's art style, several gameplay adjustments, a new lighting engine and higher resolution textures.
